name: Son Goku (Mastered Ultra Instinct)
desc: Possesses autonomous divine reflexes and universe-shattering striking power.

name: Saitama
desc: Removed his physical limiter. Boundless kinetic output and absolute invulnerability.

name: Giorno Giovanna (Gold Experience Requiem)
desc: Reverts all hostile actions and willpower back to the state of 'zero'.

name: Rimuru Tempest
origin: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
desc: A True Dragon-level Demon Lord with multiversal conceptual manipulation.

name: Anos Voldigoad
origin: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
desc: The Demon King of Tyranny. His source outright rejects logical destruction.

name: Klein Moretti (The Fool)
desc: Embodiment of the Seer pathway. Manipulates history, time, and conceptual miracles.

name: Sunless (Lost from Light)
desc: A Divine Shadow manipulator capable of manifesting an army of nightmare echoes.

name: Satoru Gojo
desc: Controls the concept of infinity. Untouchable space exists between him and reality.

name: Ryomen Sukuna
desc: The King of Curses. His spatial cleaves bisect the world itself.

name: Monkey D. Luffy (Gear 5)
desc: The Sun God Nika. Fights with absolute freedom, bending reality like rubber.

name: Naruto Uzumaki (Baryon Mode)
desc: Fuses chakra on a sub-atomic level to burn through the opponent's lifespan.

name: Ichigo Kurosaki (True Bankai)
desc: A perfect hybrid of Soul Reaper, Hollow, and Quincy. Swings can shatter dimensions.

name: Sosuke Aizen
desc: Immortal entity fused with the Hogyoku. Exercises absolute sensory hypnosis.

name: Superman (Prime One Million)
desc: Sun-dipped for 15,000 years. A living extension of the source wall.

name: Thor (Rune King)
desc: Omniscient god of thunder who erased the cycle of Ragnarok using ancient magic.

name: Kratos
desc: The Ghost of Sparta. Possesses infinite strength scaling to match his adversaries.

name: Doom Slayer
desc: An incorruptible force fueled by pure rage. His armor absorbs argent energy from the fallen.

name: Asura
desc: A demigod whose physical wrath is capable of obliterating stars and creator gods.

name: Gilgamesh
desc: The King of Heroes. Wields Ea, a sword that cleaves the conceptual fabric of the world.

name: Madara Uchiha (Ten-Tails Jinchuriki)
desc: Immortal sage possessing the Rinnegan and Truth-Seeking Orbs.
